title: Intersection of Two Linked Lists
description: Find the node where two singly linked lists intersect.

data.text: Given the heads of two singly linked lists `a` and `b`, return the node at which the two lists intersect. Return null if they do not intersect.

data.title: Nested Loops O(n*m) O(1)
Align Lengths O(n+m) O(1)
What improved
data.text: The brute force method checks every pair of nodes, which explodes as lists grow. The two-pointer trick works because each pointer walks both lists. When one pointer reaches the end, it jumps to the other list's head. After at most two full walks, the pointers either meet at the intersection or both hit null.

cards.title: Brute Force
cards.description: Compare every node of A against every node of B

cards.title: Two-Pointer Switch
cards.description: Each pointer walks both lists, switching at the end
